items.source: The bean definition is created by parsing the @Configuration class and finding the @Bean methods. In the above example, we’re defining a BeanDefinition for a singleton bean named myBean. We’re also creating a BeanDefinition for the MyConfiguration class itself.
items.translation: bean 定义是通过解析包含 @Configuration 的类并查找其中包含 @Bean 的方法来创建的。 在上述示例中，我们定义了一个名为 myBean 的单例 bean 的 BeanDefinition。 我们还为 MyConfiguration 类本身创建了一个 BeanDefinition。

items.source: There is a bean definition for the myConfiguration bean, and one for myBean. When a myBean instance is required, a BeanInstanceSupplier is called. This supplier will invoke the myBean() method on the myConfiguration bean.
items.translation: 存在一个针对 myConfiguration` 的 Bean 定义，以及一个针对 myBean 的定义。 当需要 myBean 实例时，会调用一个 BeanInstanceSupplier。 该供应器将调用 myConfiguration 上的 myBean() 方法。

items.source: When the myBean instance is required, Spring knows that it must invoke the myBean() method and use the result. When running on the JVM, @Configuration class parsing happens when your application starts and @Bean methods are invoked using reflection.
items.translation: 当需要 myBean 实例时，Spring 知道必须调用 myBean() 方法并使用其结果。 在 JVM 上运行时，@Configuration 类的解析会在应用程序启动时进行，并使用反射调用 @Bean 方法。

items.source: Spring AOT will generate code like this for all your bean definitions. It will also generate code when bean post-processing is required (for example, to call @Autowired methods). An ApplicationContextInitializer will also be generated which will be used by Spring Boot to initialize the ApplicationContext when an AOT processed application is actually run.
items.translation: Spring AOT 将为所有 bean 定义生成如下代码。当需要 bean 后处理时（例如，调用 @Autowired 方法），它也会生成代码。还会生成一个 ApplicationContextInitializer，Spring Boot 将在实际运行 AOT 处理的应用程序时使用它来初始化 ApplicationContext。

items.source: The Spring @Profile annotation and profile-specific configuration have limitations.
items.translation: Spring 的@Profile注解和针对特定配置文件的支持存在限制。

items.source: If we take a typical @Configuration class:
items.translation: 如果我们采用一个典型的 @Configuration 类：

items.source: When creating a native image, Spring operates in a different way. Rather than parsing @Configuration classes and generating bean definitions at runtime, it does it at build-time. Once the bean definitions have been discovered, they are processed and converted into source code that can be analyzed by the GraalVM compiler.
items.translation: 在创建原生镜像时，Spring 的工作方式有所不同。它不是在运行时解析 @Configuration 类并生成 Bean 定义，而是在构建时完成这些操作。一旦发现了 Bean 定义，就会对其进行处理并将其转换为 GraalVM 编译器可以分析的源代码。

items.source: You can see above that the generated code creates equivalent bean definitions to the @Configuration class, but in a direct way that can be understood by GraalVM.
items.translation: 您在上文中可以看到，生成的代码创建了与 @Configuration 类等效的 Bean 定义，但以一种 GraalVM 能够直接理解的方式进行了实现。

items.source: Static analysis of your application is performed at build-time from the main entry point.
items.translation: 应用程序的静态分析在构建时从main入口点执行。

items.source: On top of those differences, Spring uses a process called Spring Ahead-of-Time processing, which imposes further limitations. Please make sure to read at least the beginning of the next section to learn about those.
items.translation: 除了这些差异之外，Spring 还使用一种称为Spring Ahead-of-Time 处理的过程，这会带来进一步的限制。请确保至少阅读下一节的开头部分以了解相关内容。

items.source: A closed-world assumption implies, besides the limitations created by GraalVM itself, the following restrictions:
items.translation: 封闭世界假设除了GraalVM 本身造成的限制外，还带来以下限制：

items.source: GraalVM JSON hint files in META-INF/native-image/{groupId}/{artifactId}/:
items.translation: GraalVM JSON 提示文件位于 META-INF/native-image/{groupId}/{artifactId}/：

items.source: Resource hints (resource-config.json)
items.translation: 资源提示（resource-config.json）

items.source: Reflection hints (reflect-config.json)
items.translation: 反射提示（reflect-config.json）

items.source: Serialization hints (serialization-config.json)
items.translation: 序列化提示 (serialization-config.json)

items.source: Java Proxy Hints (proxy-config.json)
items.translation: Java 代理提示 (proxy-config.json)

items.source: JNI Hints (jni-config.json)
items.translation: JNI 提示（jni-config.json）

items.source: If the generated hints are not sufficient, you can also provide your own.
items.translation: 如果生成的提示不足，您也可以提供自己的提示。

items.source: Hint files are generated under META-INF/native-image where they are automatically picked up by GraalVM.
items.translation: 提示文件生成在META-INF/native-image下，GraalVM 会自动拾取这些文件。

items.source:
GraalVM Native Images provide a new way to deploy and run Java applications.
Compared to the Java Virtual Machine, native images can run with a smaller memory footprint and with much faster startup times.
items.translation: GraalVM 原生镜像提供了一种部署和运行 Java 应用程序的新方式。与 Java 虚拟机相比，原生镜像可以使用更小的内存占用并拥有更快的启动时间。

items.source: They are well suited to applications that are deployed using container images and are especially interesting when combined with "Function as a service" (FaaS) platforms.
items.translation: 它们非常适合使用容器镜像部署的应用程序，当与“函数即服务”（FaaS）平台结合使用时尤其引人注目。

items.source:
Unlike traditional applications written for the JVM, GraalVM Native Image applications require ahead-of-time processing in order to create an executable.
This ahead-of-time processing involves statically analyzing your application code from its main entry point.
items.translation: 与为 JVM 编写的传统应用程序不同，GraalVM Native Image 应用程序需要预先处理以生成可执行文件。此预先处理涉及从主入口点静态分析您的应用程序代码。

items.source:
A GraalVM Native Image is a complete, platform-specific executable.
You do not need to ship a Java Virtual Machine in order to run a native image.
items.translation: GraalVM 原生镜像是一个完整的、特定于平台的可执行文件。运行原生镜像时，您无需分发 Java 虚拟机。

items.source:
The fact that GraalVM Native Images are produced ahead-of-time means that there are some key differences between native and JVM based applications.
The main differences are:
items.translation:
GraalVM 原生镜像是提前编译生成的，这意味着原生应用与基于 JVM 的应用之间存在一些关键差异。
主要差异如下：

items.source: Code that cannot be reached when the native image is created will be removed and won’t be part of the executable.
items.translation: 无法在创建原生镜像时到达的代码将被移除，且不会包含在执行文件中。

items.source: GraalVM is not directly aware of dynamic elements of your code and must be told about reflection, resources, serialization, and dynamic proxies.
items.translation: GraalVM 无法直接感知您代码中的动态元素，必须告知其关于反射、资源、序列化和动态代理的信息。

items.source: The application classpath is fixed at build time and cannot change.
items.translation: 应用程序的类路径在构建时固定，无法更改。

items.source: There is no lazy class loading, everything shipped in the executables will be loaded in memory on startup.
items.translation: 没有懒加载，可执行文件中包含的所有内容将在启动时加载到内存中。

items.source: There are some limitations around some aspects of Java applications that are not fully supported.
items.translation: Java 应用程序的某些方面存在一些限制，这些方面尚未得到完全支持。

items.source:
Typical Spring Boot applications are quite dynamic and configuration is performed at runtime.
In fact, the concept of Spring Boot auto-configuration depends heavily on reacting to the state of the runtime in order to configure things correctly.
items.translation: 典型的 Spring Boot 应用程序非常动态，配置是在运行时执行的。事实上，Spring Boot 自动配置的概念严重依赖于对运行时状态的响应，以便正确地进行配置。

items.source:
Although it would be possible to tell GraalVM about these dynamic aspects of the application, doing so would undo most of the benefit of static analysis.
So instead, when using Spring Boot to create native images, a closed-world is assumed and the dynamic aspects of the application are restricted.
items.translation: 虽然可以将这些应用的动态方面告知 GraalVM，但这会抵消静态分析的大部分优势。因此，在使用 Spring Boot 创建原生镜像时，假设处于封闭世界（closed-world），并限制应用的动态方面。

items.source:
When these restrictions are in place, it becomes possible for Spring to perform ahead-of-time processing during build-time and generate additional assets that GraalVM can use.
A Spring AOT processed application will typically generate:
items.translation:
当这些限制到位时，Spring 便能够在构建期间执行提前处理（ahead-of-time processing），并生成 GraalVM 可用的额外资源。
经过 Spring AOT 处理的应用程序通常会生成：

items.source: Java source code
items.translation: Java 源代码

items.source: Bytecode (for dynamic proxies, etc.)
items.translation: 字节码（用于动态代理等）

items.source:
Spring applications are composed of Spring Beans.
Internally, Spring Framework uses two distinct concepts to manage beans.
There are bean instances, which are the actual instances that have been created and can be injected into other beans.
There are also bean definitions which are used to define attributes of a bean and how its instance should be created.
items.translation:
Spring 应用程序由 Spring Bean 组成。
内部地，Spring Framework 使用两个不同的概念来管理 Bean。
Bean 实例是实际已创建并可注入到其他 Bean 中的实例。
还有 Bean 定义，用于定义 Bean 的属性以及其实例应如何创建。

items.source: The Spring AOT process would convert the configuration class above to code like this:
items.translation: Spring AOT 进程会将上述配置类转换为如下代码：

items.source:
In addition to generating source files, the Spring AOT engine will also generate hint files that are used by GraalVM.
Hint files contain JSON data that describes how GraalVM should deal with things that it can’t understand by directly inspecting the code.
items.translation: 除了生成源文件外，Spring AOT 引擎还会生成供 GraalVM 使用的提示文件。提示文件包含描述 GraalVM 应如何处理无法通过直接检查代码来理解的内容的 JSON 数据。

items.source:
For example, you might be using a Spring annotation on a private method.
Spring will need to use reflection in order to invoke private methods, even on GraalVM.
When such situations arise, Spring can write a reflection hint so that GraalVM knows that even though the private method isn’t called directly, it still needs to be available in the native image.
items.translation: 例如，您可能在私有方法上使用了 Spring 注解。Spring 需要使用反射来调用私有方法，即使在 GraalVM 环境下也是如此。当出现此类情况时，Spring 可以编写一个反射提示（reflection hint），以便 GraalVM 知道尽管该私有方法未被直接调用，但在原生镜像中仍需保留其可用性。

items.source:
Spring sometimes needs to generate proxy classes to enhance the code you’ve written with additional features.
To do this, it uses the cglib library which directly generates bytecode.
items.translation: Spring 有时需要生成代理类，以通过添加额外功能来增强您编写的代码。为此，它使用 cglib 库直接生成字节码。

items.source:
When an application is running on the JVM, proxy classes are generated dynamically as the application runs.
When creating a native image, these proxies need to be created at build-time so that they can be included by GraalVM.
items.translation:
当应用程序在 JVM 上运行时，代理类会在运行时动态生成。
在创建原生镜像时，这些代理类需要在构建时生成，以便 GraalVM 将其包含在内。

items.source: Although AOT generated source code can be verbose, it is quite readable and can be helpful when debugging an application. Generated source files can be found in target/spring-aot/main/sources when using Maven and build/generated/aotSources with Gradle.
items.translation: 尽管 AOT 生成的源代码可能冗长，但它非常易读，在调试应用程序时很有帮助。 使用 Maven 时，生成的源文件位于 target/spring-aot/main/sources；使用 Gradle 时，则位于 build/generated/aotSources。

items.source: Generated hint files can be found in target/spring-aot/main/resources when using Maven and build/generated/aotResources with Gradle.
items.translation: 生成的提示文件在使用 Maven 时位于 target/spring-aot/main/resources，使用 Gradle 时位于 build/generated/aotResources。

items.source: If you just want to get started and experiment with GraalVM you can jump to the Developing Your First GraalVM Native Application section and return to this section later.

items.source: The Native Image Compatibility Guide section of the GraalVM reference documentation provides more details about GraalVM limitations.
items.translation: GraalVM 参考文档中的Native Image Compatibility Guide（原生镜像兼容性指南）部分提供了有关 GraalVM 限制的更多详细信息。

items.source: The exact code generated may differ depending on the nature of your bean definitions.
items.translation: 生成的确切代码可能因您的 Bean 定义性质而异。

items.source: During Spring AOT processing, your application is started up to the point that bean definitions are available. Bean instances are not created during the AOT processing phase.
items.translation: 在 Spring AOT 处理期间，您的应用程序会启动到 bean 定义可用的阶段。 bean 实例不会在 AOT 处理阶段创建。
